opus.problem: Calling him the first king of the northern tribes, together with the two golden calves at Bethel and Dan, gives the word away in one clue. This is not medium hard. Drop 'first king of the northern tribes' and use a looser label such as 'this king'.

'Son of Nebat' is his well-known epithet, used again and again in Kings, and it is one of the accepted answers. Naming his father gives the word away, so this clue is not medium hard. Describe him as an Ephraimite servant of Solomon instead.
